description: This is a source interface file defining IContentStream in the PdfSharp.Pdf.Advanced namespace, specifying methods for accessing font, image, and form resources in a PDF content stream.

classes.name: IContentStream
classes.description: Interface for managing PDF content streams, including resource access and font, image, and form naming.

methods.name: Resources
methods.description: Property to get the PdfResources associated with the content stream.

methods.name: GetFontName (XGlyphTypeface glyphTypeface, FontType fontType, out PdfFont pdfFont)
methods.description: Method to retrieve the font name given a glyph typeface and font type; outputs the associated PdfFont.

methods.name: GetFontName (string idName, byte[] fontData, out PdfFont pdfFont)
methods.description: Method to retrieve the font name given an identifier and font data; outputs the associated PdfFont.

methods.name: GetImageName (XImage image)
methods.description: Method to retrieve the name of an image resource.

methods.name: GetFormName (XForm form)
methods.description: Method to retrieve the name of a form resource.
